objective: Close R115's demonstrated scheduler-coverage hole by preserving its exact per-request prefill MLP arm and extending the same per-request boundary isolation to multi-request ordinary decode, speculative decode, and mixed phases.

rationale.causal_positive: All 19 counted packed-c2 prefill batches treated by R115 were exact across all 38 outputs and both request orders, versus only 1/20 exact batches in R108.
rationale.coverage_failure: R115's only counted miss entered as one prefill request and acquired the second active request during decode; R115 deliberately controls rather than isolates every decode or mixed phase.
rationale.known_divergence: cache-c000 diverged from token 96 with the same 348-to-2972 branch seen before R115.

single_change.scope: Only the existing opaque layer-0 dense-MLP custom op.
single_change.single_request: Call the loaded MLP once on the unchanged input tensor.
single_change.multi_request: Reconstruct scheduler-order request lengths from live GDNAttentionMetadata spec/non-spec query starts and masks; call the unchanged loaded MLP once per request and concatenate in original scheduler order.
single_change.packed_prefill: Preserve R115's per-request matrix shapes and arithmetic.
single_change.decode_and_mixed: Newly isolate each active request, including MTP speculative-token groups.

mandatory_gates.source: Require exact R115 base identity, one generalized metadata-boundary helper, the existing layer-0/linear-attention call guard, and fail-closed boundary coverage.
mandatory_gates.startup: Profile must execute the single-request control and reach HTTP ready.
mandatory_gates.runtime: Require distinct packed-prefill and decode-or-mixed multi-request execution markers before interpreting the corresponding gates.
mandatory_gates.identity: Every output must be 128 tokens, cached_tokens=0, and exactly match the frozen complete-token oracle.
mandatory_gates.abort: Abort interpretation after any warm c1 mismatch; no performance claim after any identity mismatch.

workload.warmup: One c1 repeat and two simultaneous c2 repeats.
workload.staggered_gate: At least four c2 repeats with a fixed launch stagger chosen before the run to force the R115-uncovered decode-or-mixed marker.
workload.qualification: Three c1 and twenty simultaneous c2 repeats after warmup.

decision.pass: Run a fresh-server factorial without inherited R108 projection isolation/tracing, then strict varied-prompt realistic quality and performance qualification on a clean boot.
decision.fail: Keep R115/R116 diagnostic-only and localize the remaining layer-0 residual/consumer boundary without weakening identity.

resource_boundary: 12 GiB container RAM, 16 GiB RAM-plus-swap, no reboot or GPU reset.
reporting_boundary: Diagnostic only. No README, website, LocalMaxxing, or public speed/quality update from R116's narrow oracle workload.
